name: Origin
description: Different dreams once shared a single address. Kristen looks toward a sky whose limits she refuses to accept. What begins as a question becomes an institution. / Lone Trail: CW-10 END.

name: A Name
description: She has a name, and a future of her own. In the space between Silence and Ifrit, research acquires a responsibility that no result can erase. / Lone Trail: CW-9 END.

name: Fracture
description: Ambition does not belong to science alone. With Hooleyak, knowledge becomes a bargain: the same horizon can conceal very different intentions. / Lone Trail: CW-6 BEG.

name: The Dream
description: What if pain could be kept outside a dream? Dorothy imagines a refuge for people whose lives have been made expendable. The tenderness of that wish makes its cost harder to see. / Dorothy's Vision: DV-8 END.

name: The Subjects
description: Beyond the promise of peace, someone is still waiting to wake. A laboratory can count its subjects; responsibility begins when it sees the people inside those numbers. / Dorothy's Vision: DV-6 BEG.

name: Awakening
description: A future cannot be given without the freedom to refuse it. Waking breaks the perfect enclosure and returns uncertainty, pain and possibility to the people who must live with them. / Dorothy's Vision: DV-8 END.

name: Horizon
description: Another question remains overhead. Beyond the laboratory and its fractures, the sky persists as an unfinished experiment. Every answer makes the boundary more visible. / Dorothy's Vision: DV-ST-2.

name: Intersection
description: Paths that separated meet again. Shared history survives disagreement, but it cannot make the next decision for either person. / Lone Trail: CW-6 END.

name: Ascent
description: All eyes turn toward the same sky. An impossible machine rises on accumulated labor, sacrifice and belief. The dream is singular; its consequences are shared. / Lone Trail: CW-8 END.

name: Parting
description: To have travelled together is not to share the final destination. At the threshold, devotion and refusal can look like opposite forms of the same care. / Lone Trail: CW-10 BEG.

name: Daybreak
description: A pause in the ascent: morning returns us to the world below. This memory from Dorothy's Vision asks what remains worth protecting, even while someone reaches for the stars. / Dorothy's Vision: DV-8 BEG.

name: Farewell
description: At last, the imagined distance becomes a view. Discovery opens a world and leaves another behind. The farewell belongs as much to those below as to the traveller. / Lone Trail: CW-ST-4.

name: Belonging
description: Those who remain must also find a way forward. Belonging is neither a perfect institution nor a sealed refuge; it is the possibility of being understood by another person. / Lone Trail: CW-ST-3.

name: The Way Forward
description: The future also begins with a hand offered to someone beside you. After the ascent, Silence and Saria bring the exhibition back to a human scale: care, consequence, and the work that continues. / Lone Trail: CW-ST-3.
